policy.instruction: Run each candidate twice; pinned clean GLM once more; stop after Step 3.
policy.qualification: Both candidate replicates must fall inside the two baseline runs min/max for useful incident exits, control exits, control high flags and control exit-or-high, for both raw and agreement-filtered scores.
policy.baseline_spread: Observed range of two runs, not a confidence interval. No pooling that hides a bad repeat.
policy.recommendation: Lowest mean token cost per full replay among qualifying candidates; ties broken by pooled median latency. If none qualifies retain GLM 8000.
policy.lead_policy: Report pooled latency and per-run median lead plus their observed ranges; lead is diagnostic, not an extra acceptance threshold beyond the user rule.
policy.settings: Pinned baseline prompt; no retrieval; temperature 0; seed 7; nonstreaming; only model/max_tokens vary.
policy.thinking: GLM and Qwen3.6 default thinking remains on; Qwen3-VL Instruct is non-reasoning. max_tokens includes reasoning and final output, not a separate reasoning-only cap.
policy.forecast_method: Pinned clean prompt/completion counts at live prices; completion counts capped at each requested token budget. Cost forecast only, not a guarantee.
policy.signature_policy: Require model preflight and verified provider_tee availability; fetch exact-byte EIP-191 signatures for every new response. Unverified signatures block recommendation, not behavioral schema scoring.
policy.reuse_policy: Pinned Step 2 baseline is behavioral evidence with sampled metadata checks, not retroactively claimed to have full preflight verification.
